summary: Russia conducted a massive 25-hour drone and missile offensive across at least 15 Ukrainian regions, employing Shahed-type UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and reactive drones targeting energy infrastructure and population centers. Strikes hit a thermal power plant in Bila Tserkva, the Lukoil refinery in Kstovo (Russia), and residential areas in Vinnytsia (two dead, three children injured) and Chernivtsi (one injured). Russian missile forces remain at high readiness with Iskander-M, Zircon, Onyx-M, and KN-23 systems deployed in Bryansk, Kursk, Rostov, and Voronezh regions, posing continued ballistic threat to Kyiv and central Ukraine.
key_points: Massive 25-hour Shahed/Geran-5 drone campaign active across 15+ Ukrainian regions with simultaneous launches from multiple directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77722)
Geran-5 missile struck thermal power plant in Bila Tserkva, Kyiv region, confirming energy infrastructure targeting. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77726)
Ukrainian drones attacked Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod region, Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85042)
Vinnytsia strike killed two civilians and injured three children between dormitory and educational facility in Koziatyn community. (Source: @eRadarrua/127889, @UkraineNow/85051)
Chernivtsi drone attack damaged administrative building, hospitalizing a 67-year-old man. (Source: @UkraineNow/85049)

Russian ballistic missile readiness includes Iskander-M, Zircon, Onyx-M in Bryansk/Kursk/Rostov and KN-23 in Voronezh threatening Kyiv, Cherkasy, Poltava, Zhytomyr, Dnipropetrovsk. (Source: @eRadarrua/127882)
Zelensky claims October Russian losses of 54,400 killed/wounded, daily record 2,250 on Oct 21, and 96.2 sq km liberated. (Source: @UkraineNow/85048)
Reactive UAVs and strike drone groups maneuvered dynamically across Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa corridors. (Source: @kpszsu/92073, @eRadarrua/127866)

sections.executive_summary: Russia executed a sustained 25-hour multi-axis drone and missile offensive across 15+ Ukrainian regions, employing Shahed UAVs, Geran-5 cruise missiles, and reactive drones against energy infrastructure, urban centers, and military targets. Critical strikes included a Geran-5 hit on the Bila Tserkva thermal power plant, Ukrainian drone attack on the Lukoil refinery in Kstovo (Russia), and lethal strikes in Vinnytsia (two dead, three children wounded) and Chernivtsi (one injured). Russian ballistic missile forces remain at elevated readiness with advanced systems positioned in western Russian regions threatening central Ukraine.

points: Ukrainian air defense monitoring networks tracked over 100 incoming Shahed-type UAVs, Geran-5 missiles, and reactive drones across 15 oblasts during a 25-hour continuous offensive, with real-time trajectory data showing complex routing through Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kyiv, Vinnytsia, and western regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @kpszsu/92073)

Civilian casualties confirmed in Vinnytsia oblast where a Russian strike hit between a dormitory and educational institution in Koziatyn community, killing a man instantly and a woman in resuscitation, while hospitalizing three children including two five-year-olds and a 16-year-old boy. (Source: @eRadarrua/127889, @UkraineNow/85051)
Chernivtsi suffered a drone attack damaging an administrative building and injuring a 67-year-old man who was hospitalized, marking a rare strike on the western city. (Source: @UkraineNow/85049)

President Zelensky reported October as a record month for Russian losses with 54,400 killed and seriously wounded, a single-day high of 2,250 on October 21, and Ukrainian forces liberating 96.2 square kilometers — 10.4 more than Russia captured. (Source: @UkraineNow/85048)

Ukrainian long-range drones successfully struck the Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez refinery in Kstovo, Nizhny Novgorod region, demonstrating continued capability to target Russian energy infrastructure deep inside Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/85042)

Russian forces launched a coordinated 25-hour drone offensive involving over 100 Shahed-type UAVs and Geran-5 missiles from multiple launch axes including Sumy, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Cherkasy, Kyiv, and Chernihiv directions, with dynamic routing adjustments mid-flight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @kpszsu/92073)

Ballistic missile forces maintained high readiness with Iskander-M, RM-48U, Zircon, and Onyx-M systems deployed in Bryansk, Kursk, and Rostov oblasts, plus North Korean KN-23 missiles in Voronezh oblast, threatening Kyiv, Cherkasy, Poltava, Zhytomyr, and Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/127882)

Geran-5 cruise missiles specifically targeted energy infrastructure, striking the thermal power plant in Bila Tserkva (Kyiv region) and tracking toward Rivne city, indicating a focus on degrading Ukrainian power generation. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77726, @mon1tor_ua/77728)

Russian drone tactics included 'snake' maneuvering formations (8 Shaheds from Poltava through northern Cherkasy toward Kyiv's Obukhiv and Bila Tserkva districts) and reactive UAVs penetrating to Mykolaiv (Voznesensk area) and Odesa (Velykyi Dalnyk) regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @eRadarrua/127858)

Launch volumes surged with 15 Shaheds from Sumy to Poltava (Lubny), 14 from Poltava to Cherkasy (Zolotonosha), 14 from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, and 13 from Cherkasy toward Kyiv and Vinnytsia in a single wave. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694)

Dnipropetrovsk region hosted the highest concentration of strike UAV groups (8 groups per eRadarrua/127884) with reactive drones moving west toward Lebedynske, Malynivka, Pervomaiske, and Sukhanivka, while additional UAVs tracked toward Zaporizhzhia from the south. (Source: @eRadarrua/127866, @kpszsu/92131, @kpszsu/92112)

Russian strike UAVs transited eastern Dnipropetrovsk oblast on westward courses, with 14 Shaheds launched from Dnipropetrovsk toward Poltava region and 7 more toward Poltava city in subsequent waves. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Reactive UAVs from Kharkiv region flew toward Poltava (Poltavskyi district) and westward, while strike UAVs from northern Sumy moved south through the eastern front corridor. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77727, @kpszsu/92130, @kpszsu/92108)

Kropyvnytskyi (Kirovohrad) faced repeated reactive UAV approaches from Dnipropetrovsk (Oleksandriia district) and over-Dnipro transits, with Geran-5 missiles also crossing the Dnipro toward the city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77719, @mon1tor_ua/77729)

Sumy region served as a primary launch corridor with 15 Shaheds toward Poltava (Lubny), 6 toward Poltava (Myrhorod), 2 Geran-5 missiles toward Lubny, and strike UAV groups moving south through Sumy/Poltava/Cherkasy toward western Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @mon1tor_ua/77729, @kpszsu/92073)

Chernihiv launched 2 Shaheds toward Kyiv's Boryspil district, while Kharkiv hosted reactive UAVs in the center moving north toward Kharkiv city, west toward Poltava, and southwest, plus strike UAVs on northern Sumy moving south. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77698, @kpszsu/92108, @kpszsu/92111, @kpszsu/92130)

Kyiv region faced multi-directional threats: 8 Shaheds from Poltava through Cherkasy toward Obukhiv/Bila Tserkva, 3 from Cherkasy to Obukhiv, 1 Geran-5 on Bila Tserkva TEC, 1 Shahed from Troieshchyna to Obolon/Podil, and strike UAVs targeting Hrebinky, Rzhyshchiv, Kaharlyk, and Fastiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77726, @mon1tor_ua/77696, @eRadarrua/127876, @eRadarrua/127875, @kpszsu/92124, @kpszsu/92114)

Cherkasy region acted as both target and transit hub: 8 Shaheds toward Zolotonosha/Kaniv, 5 strike UAV groups toward Bohdany, Kaniv, Komarivka, Lipyave, Syniokivka, Skybyn, reactive UAVs toward Krymky and Vinnytsia, and incoming waves from Poltava (11+3 Shaheds) and Sumy (via Poltava). (Source: @eRadarrua/127863, @eRadarrua/127866, @eRadarrua/127875, @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @mon1tor_ua/77729)

Mykolaiv region detected UAVs in the north moving northwest and a reactive Shahed falling near Voznesensk, indicating southern penetration from Dnipropetrovsk or Kherson directions. (Source: @kpszsu/92122, @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Odesa region faced a reactive Shahed approaching Velykyi Dalnyk from the north, while a Geran-5 missile transited Dnipro toward Kirovohrad region from the east. (Source: @eRadarrua/127858, @mon1tor_ua/77716)

Kharkiv region hosted reactive UAVs in central, western, and southern sectors with courses north toward Kharkiv city, west toward Poltava, and southwest, plus strike UAVs on northern Sumy moving south. (Source: @kpszsu/92111, @kpszsu/92108, @mon1tor_ua/77727)

Dnipropetrovsk-based UAVs repeatedly crossed the Dnipro River toward Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi, Oleksandriia, Vasylivka) and westward toward Zaporizhzhia, sustaining pressure on the southern flank. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77719, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @eRadarrua/127866, @kpszsu/92131)

Unprecedented 25-hour continuous Shahed/Geran-5 offensive involved over 100 drones across 15+ oblasts with complex routing: Sumy→Poltava→Cherkasy→Kyiv/Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk→Poltava/Cherkasy/Kirovohrad, Kharkiv→Poltava, Kyiv→Zhytomyr/Vinnytsia, Vinnytsia→Zhytomyr/Khmelnytskyi, Khmelnytskyi→Rivne/Ternopil, Rivne→Lviv/Volyn, Chernihiv→Kyiv, Ternopil→Lviv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77694, @mon1tor_ua/77716, @mon1tor_ua/77718, @mon1tor_ua/77727, @mon1tor_ua/77729, @kpszsu/92073)

Geran-5 cruise missiles (upgraded Shahed variants) struck strategic targets: thermal power plant in Bila Tserkva (Kyiv) and tracked toward Rivne city, while Ukrainian drones hit Lukoil refinery in Kstovo (Nizhny Novgorod, Russia). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77726, @mon1tor_ua/77728, @UkraineNow/85042)
